latestTerminalSummary:
Reviser science complete and saved before native Goal terminal completion (goal-01a1221a, complete at 19:22 UTC, 12 min before deadline).

Top finding: the critique's F3 sentence claiming oral-history video would benefit from clamav-large-archive-scanner is wrong on primary evidence — the tool's README states it "will not enable you [to] scan large documents, graphics, videos," so I accepted the tool as an archives-only evaluated alternative and kept the documented-non-scan lane mandatory for large non-archives.

Saved in the allowed write root only:
- [final.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M12-A/control/reviser/final.md) (41 KB) — one coherent final covering O1–O6 and all P clauses, with §8 explicitly accepting/amending/rejecting/holding-uncertain every observed criticism
- [source-map.json](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M12-A/control/reviser/source-map.json) — 4 immutable reviser IDs (R01–R04) plus predecessor reuse map
- `sources/evidence.md` + `sources/index.md` — bounded excerpts and navigable index

Key adjudications: F1 accepted (floor ≥1.2.1, confirmed via primary PR #1039 read); F2 accepted (P2 split correction/enhancement); F3 accepted-with-amendment (above); F4 accepted (as-received byte retention); F5 accepted (bagit-python now triply confirmed); M1 accepted via tar demotion (README has no serialization flags); M2/M5/M6(+V8)/M9 applied; M3/M4/M7 accepted as no-action. The critique file is truncated mid-V2-verdict, so V2-onward critic verdicts are recorded as retained uncertainty (U7) with items preserved as written. No sandbox existed; executed checks: none, all validations proposed.
